question: A company started with 216 units. They added 31. They added 74. They multiplied by 5. They removed 151. They removed 58 more. How many units remain?

A store started with 203 items. They added 56 from inventory. They multiplied by 9 for display. They added 26 more items. They removed 166 in a sale. How many items does the store have (as a collection)?
A warehouse had 94 boxes. They multiplied by 5. They added 78. They removed 465. They removed 70 more. They multiplied by 9. How many boxes does the warehouse have?

A worker started with 91 tasks. They tripled the workload. They multiplied by 5 again. They removed 360 tasks completed. They multiplied by 9 for new projects. They added 37 tasks. How many tasks remain?

A factory started with 100 units. They removed 25. They added 59. They doubled. They multiplied by 5. They tripled. They multiplied by 7. How many units were produced?

A worker started with 107 tasks. They multiplied by 6. They multiplied by 5. They divided by 6. They added 73. They multiplied by 4. How many tasks must be completed?
A factory had 218 units. They multiplied by 4. They multiplied by 8. They added 40. They added 79 more. How many units were produced?
